build_MLP: build a python module to create an MLP with configurable depth, width, and skip connections
build_NerfMLP: build a python module to create a NeRF MLP that outputs sigma and RGB values
build_SinusoidalEncoder: build a python module to encode positions using sinusoidal positional encoding for NeRF
build_VanillaNeRFRadianceField: build a python module to create a vanilla NeRF radiance field with position and view encoders
build_DNeRFRadianceField: build a python module to create a dynamic NeRF radiance field with spatial and temporal warping
